skipped for deletion ?
Done
handling exception is not specified.
Updated the doxygen with exception details
Done

Calling a function just to check if that is a directory or file is an overhead because of function stacking.
Can't we check here itself if it is a directory then only call "skipDeletion"?
Done

Instead of multiple loops, I would suggest to go for a recursive solution so that this logic can be applied in case going forward multiple such exception is required.

A directory can have mix of file or other directory inside it.
The implementation should be such that, if the directory is marked to skip then preserve all the files under that directory and check for other directories under it.
If they are marked for skip, don't delete the and then this logic should recursively apply on all the sub directories. 

SkipDeletion should maintain a list which can be used to match if the directory is marked for deletion or not.
Done
should we have log in case system path doesn't exists ?
This API is responsible for deleting the FRU VPD present in the persisted path, it is not required to check if system path exists.
Acknowledged
this part of the code is same as above, can we define lambda function for this ?
Added new API
We don't need to limit it to these paths. Else every addition in list will make us update the doxygen..
Done
should we improve API name, it should suggest what the api is doing.
Done

This API is performing selective removal of directory. Can we rename the API to be close to what it is performing.
eg: pruneDirectoryTree
Done
Can we move both the APIs to utility?
Done, moved to commonUtility
We can reduce the indentation here by checking this condition under with "!" and continuing from here itself?
Done
We can continue from here and reduce the indentation below as else will not be required?
Done
should we use o_directoryRemoved as return type instead ?
Why do you think so @anupama.b.r1@ibm.com? Could you please put down, what are the pros and cons of the change requested?
agree, I missed point here as deleteDirectory is recursive api, we can't retain directory remove status with recursive call, unless we use static variable.

as its recursive api, this should not be reset every time, otherwise will loose the prev error code ?
and also latest error code will replace old error code.
should we avoid o_errCode, and just relay on the "o_directoryRemoved" in the caller ?

No, That should not be required as we don't want error to propagate to the parent call. We can handle error code after each recursive call return as suggested below.

This way we will preserve the format in which we want utility methods to be.
Done
Instead of logging here, just return the error code from here.
Done
Th error code defined after try can be re-used? Just need to clear here for every iteration?
Done
Done
as this api skips certain directories, doesn't remove given directory entirely, should this be part of IbmHandler ?
This is a generic functionality, can be used outside OEM code. At max we can wrap the list defined in utility under OEM tag.
ok, unless skipping of 'system', 'logical_bmc' etc folders are generic requirement for all kind systems, we use OEM tag or move under oem handler.
